text: To compute Extⁿ_R(M, N) from a projective resolution P• → M, one:
choices: applies Hom_R(−, N) to P• with M deleted, then takes cohomology of the resulting cochain complex
applies Hom_R(N, −) to the full resolution including M
tensors P• with N and takes homology
applies Hom_R(−, N) to the full resolution including M, then takes cohomology
explanation: The augmentation M is dropped before applying the functor — otherwise the complex would stay exact in a trivial way and all higher cohomology would vanish. Tensoring P• with N instead computes Tor. Independence from the chosen resolution follows from the comparison theorem.
